cards.ex: They've had a rocky relationship for years, always breaking up and getting back together.
cards.exUz: Ularning munosabatlari bir necha yillardan beri murakkab, doim ajralishib, qayta uchrashishadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin, muammoli, doimiy janjallar bilan kechadigan munosabatlar.

cards.ex: It took her a long time to get over her ex-boyfriend.
cards.exUz: U sobiq yigitini unutishi uchun uzoq vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi romantik munosabatlarni unutish, o'ziga kelish.

cards.ex: Sarah and her sister are on the outs after that argument.
cards.exUz: Sara va uning singlisi o'sha janjaldan keyin xafa bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan urishib qolgan, munosabatlari buzilgan holat.

cards.ex: I truly believe that he is my soulmate; we understand each other so well.
cards.exUz: Men uning haqiqiy qadrdonim ekanligiga ishonaman; biz bir-birimizni juda yaxshi tushunamiz.
cards.uzDef: Hayotda juda yaqin, tushunadigan, mos keladigan inson.

cards.ex: The family feud has been going on for generations over land ownership.
cards.exUz: Oila nizosi yer egaligi tufayli avlodlardan avlodga o'tib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolari o'rtasidagi uzoq davom etgan jiddiy kelishmovchilik.

cards.ex: She wears her heart on her sleeve, so everyone knows when she's upset.
cards.exUz: U o'z his-tuyg'ularini ochiqchasiga ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun u xafa bo'lganida hamma biladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z hissiyotlarini ochiqchasiga ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: They're such a match made in heaven; they complement each other perfectly.
cards.exUz: Ular shunday mos juftlikki, bir-birlarini mukammal to'ldirishadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda mos keladigan juftlik.

cards.ex: It's important for siblings to get along with each other.
cards.exUz: Aka-uka va opa-singillar bir-birlari bilan kelishishlari muhim.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda yaxshi bo'lmoq, do'stona munosabatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: They come from a very close-knit family, always supporting each other.
cards.exUz: Ular juda ahil oiladan chiqqan, har doim bir-birlarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda yaqin, bog'langan, doimiy aloqada bo'lgan oila.

cards.ex: It was love at first sight; they knew they were meant to be together.
cards.exUz: Bu birinchi ko'rishda sevgi edi; ular birga bo'lishlari kerakligini bilishardi.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi ko'rishdanoq kuchli romantik his-tuyg'ularni his qilish.

cards.ex: He's a talented musician, just like his father; like father, like son.
cards.exUz: U otasi kabi iste'dodli musiqachi; otasi kabi o'g'il.
cards.uzDef: Ota va farzand bir xil xususiyatlarga ega ekanligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: Her granddaughter is the apple of her eye.
cards.exUz: Uning nabirasi uning ko'z qorachig'i.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir eng sevimli, juda qadrli insoni.

cards.ex: They're birds of a feather; they both love to travel and explore new cultures.
cards.exUz: Ular bir xil odamlar; ular sayohat qilishni va yangi madaniyatlarni o'rganishni yaxshi ko'rishadi.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash xususiyatlarga, qiziqishlarga ega bo'lgan odamlar.

cards.ex: My mother-in-law is always breathing down my neck about how I raise my children.
cards.exUz: Qaynonam doimiy ravishda farzandlarimni qanday tarbiyalashim haqida meni ta'qib qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini doimiy nazorat ostida ushlab turish, qattiq kuzatuv.

cards.ex: He comes from a broken home, which explains his reluctance to commit.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi buzilgan, shuning uchun uning majburiyat olishni istamasligi tushunarli.
cards.uzDef: Ota-onalari ajrashgan yoki alohida yashaydigan oila.

cards.ex: My sister and I don't always see eye to eye, but we respect each other's opinions.
cards.exUz: Singlim bilan doim ham fikrimiz bir xil bo'lmasa ham, bir-birimizning fikrlarimizni hurmat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida bir xil fikrda bo'lish, kelishish.

cards.ex: Children thrive best in a nurturing environment where they feel safe and loved.
cards.exUz: Bolalar o'zlarini xavfsiz va sevilgan his qiladigan g'amxo'r muhitda eng yaxshi rivojlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Bolani yoki shaxsni o'sishi va rivojlanishi uchun qulay va qo'llab-quvvatlovchi muhit.

cards.ex: I'll always stand by you, no matter what happens.
cards.exUz: Nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, men har doim seni qo'llab-quvvatlayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini qiyin paytlarda qo'llab-quvvatlash va yordam berish.

cards.ex: They seemed to be living in domestic bliss until the scandal broke.
cards.exUz: Mojaro kelib chiqquncha ular oilaviy baxtda yashayotgandek edi.
cards.uzDef: Nikoh yoki oilaviy hayotdagi baxt va farovonlik.

cards.ex: She and her sister fell out over a misunderstanding.
cards.exUz: U va singlisi tushunmovchilik tufayli urushib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlar yoki oila a'zolari o'rtasida janjallashib qolish yoki munosabatlarni buzish.

cards.ex: They own a family-run business that's been around for generations.
cards.exUz: Ular bir necha avloddan beri mavjud bo'lgan oilaviy biznesga egalik qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Oilaviy a'zolar tomonidan boshqariladigan va egalik qilinadigan biznes.

cards.ex: They managed an amicable split after years of marriage.
cards.exUz: Ular ko'p yillik nikohdan keyin do'stona ajralishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki kishi bir-biriga nisbatan g'azablanmasdan yoki jang qilmasdan ajralishadi.

cards.ex: The new baby is a bundle of joy for the whole family.
cards.exUz: Yangi chaqaloq butun oila uchun quvonch manbai.
cards.uzDef: Yangi tug'ilgan chaqaloq, juda ko'p quvonch keltiradigan.

cards.ex: After their argument, they decided to mend fences and move on.
cards.exUz: Janjallaridan so'ng, ular yarashib, davom etishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlardagi kelishmovchiliklarni bartaraf etish, yarashish.

cards.ex: There wasn't a shadow of a doubt in her mind that he was the one.
cards.exUz: Uning ongida u aynan o'sha odam ekanligiga shubha yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Shubha hissi, hatto kichkina bo'lsa ham.

cards.ex: He's really grown into his role as a father.
cards.exUz: U otalik rolini haqiqatan ham o'zlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan biror kishiga yoki narsaga moslashish.

cards.ex: It took a while, but she finally opened up to me about her past.
cards.exUz: Biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi, lekin u nihoyat menga o'zining o'tmishi haqida dardlashdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini yoki muammolarini biror kishiga aytib berish.

cards.ex: I realized he was just a fair-weather friend when I needed help.
cards.exUz: Men yordamga muhtoj bo'lganimda u shunchaki yaxshi kun do'sti ekanligini angladim.
cards.uzDef: Faqatgina yaxshi paytlarda do'st bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: She has a heart of gold and always helps those in need.
cards.exUz: Uning oltin yuragi bor va har doim muhtojlarga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Mehribon, saxiy va rahm-shafqatli odam.

cards.ex: A successful marriage requires a lot of give and take.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatli nikoh ko'p kelishuvni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlardagi muvaffaqiyat uchun har ikki tomonning ham o'zaro kelishuvga tayyorligi.
